journeys.scenario: New entity context → TB/GL → mapping → AJE → reconciliation → statements → package → close
journeys.expected: Every displayed/exported amount reconciles to the same scope and exact inputs; no draft step is silently skipped.

journeys.scenario: Same account code and period label in two clients
journeys.expected: No shared data, authority, cache, row, mapping, export or evidence leakage.

journeys.scenario: Existing browser circuit navigates to another unauthorized context
journeys.expected: Prior content/IDs/counts/download links clear before new load; no full-page reload needed to enforce denial.

journeys.scenario: User grant/session revoked after opening approval dialog
journeys.expected: Handler denies and UI clears protected content; no approval persists.

journeys.scenario: Two reviewers act on same expected revision
journeys.expected: Unique/optimistic concurrency rule yields one applicable decision or explicit conflict, not duplicate contradictory approval.

journeys.scenario: Duplicate command, same OperationId/body
journeys.expected: One mutation/result; retry reauthorizes. Changed body with same ID conflicts.

journeys.scenario: Import interrupted, duplicate/resumed/out-of-order chunk
journeys.expected: Consistent staged state; no source seal before full expected counts/hash; prior accepted source remains.

journeys.scenario: Macro/formula/external-link/fake-XLSX/decompression attack
journeys.expected: Bounded failure with safe issue list; no parser execution, network request or partial acceptance.

journeys.scenario: Missing opening data or GL-only account
journeys.expected: Completeness stays incomplete; missing is not zero; UI and export agree.

journeys.scenario: New accepted AJE after initial plan
journeys.expected: Adjustment-set membership changes; old statement/package cannot be newly approved as current.

journeys.scenario: Partial/rejected management AJE
journeys.expected: No unbalanced subset applied; remainder visible for human evaluation; fresh balanced revision when needed.

journeys.scenario: Replacement TB includes a former adjustment
journeys.expected: Fresh reflection decision; no double count; old result preserved.

journeys.scenario: Approved reconciliation supporting document replaced
journeys.expected: Old proof/review historical; currentness stale and downstream finalization blocked.

journeys.scenario: Cash-flow noncash movement included by mistake
journeys.expected: Validation identifies classification/bridge mismatch; no balancing cash plug.

journeys.scenario: Comparative mapping/source changes after current review
journeys.expected: Current dependent statement stale; as-issued historical output unchanged.

journeys.scenario: Error restatement versus estimate change
journeys.expected: Approved distinct period treatment, disclosure and lineage; no universal retrospective or current-P&L shortcut.

journeys.scenario: Required disclosure removed/added after build
journeys.expected: Set-membership hash changes even when balances do not; prior review no longer authorizes current package.

journeys.scenario: XLSX succeeds, DOCX/PDF generation or artifact publication fails
journeys.expected: Package not sealed/advanced; successful intermediate files explicitly nonpublished; retry deterministic.

journeys.scenario: Source acceptance races package rendering
journeys.expected: Worker cannot publish against obsolete generation; no current success notification.

journeys.scenario: Artifact bytes tampered after rendering
journeys.expected: Digest check blocks seal/review/download/release handoff as applicable; historical identity not rewritten to match tamper.

journeys.scenario: Closed period receives import/journal command
journeys.expected: Denied; authorized amendment creates successor with fresh required decisions.

journeys.scenario: Group-only reviewer requests component private artifact
journeys.expected: Group result allowed, source file denied; no sensitive filename/details leak.

journeys.scenario: Missing rate, rate direction reversed, unsupported ownership
journeys.expected: No final figures asserted; clear bounded method/input requirement.

journeys.scenario: Intercompany mismatch or overlapping journal source inclusion
journeys.expected: Unmatched difference visible; duplicate consumption rejected; no plug.

journeys.scenario: Component package replaced during group approval
journeys.expected: Manifest mismatch blocks old run; explicit new pin/run required; old group result retained.

journeys.scenario: Entity close/group close sequencing
journeys.expected: No mutual prerequisite deadlock; reviewed components feed group work without inventing approvals.

journeys.scenario: Upgrade prior schema with ambiguous/null context
journeys.expected: Data preserved, unresolved links quarantined, no fabricated approval/currency/book.

journeys.scenario: Restore DB/artifacts and resume interrupted durable work
journeys.expected: Exact manifest/digest reconciliation; stale leases fenced; no duplicate external effects or falsely completed operations.

journeys.scenario: Keyboard-only and responsive forms
journeys.expected: Labels, field/summary errors, focus, line add/remove, dialog cancellation and dirty navigation usable without losing context.

journeys.scenario: Entity and group package delivered to existing release/archive contracts
journeys.expected: Exact sealed/reviewed artifacts handed off; no source recomputation, Purview requirement or signature-provider side effect introduced.

fixtures.expected: Allocated 0.003333, 0.003333, 0.003334; sum 0.010000. No unexplained account or loss of 0.000001.

fixtures.inputs: Ledger 10,000; supporting bank statement 10,200; deposit in transit +500; outstanding cheque −800; accepted unreflected ledger bank fee −100.
fixtures.expected: Explained ledger 9,900; explained support 9,900; residual 0. If ledger basis is already adjusted to 9,900, fee is not added again.

fixtures.title: GOLD-R2R-04 — cash flow
fixtures.inputs: Opening cash 1,000; operating +200; investing −300; financing +100; FX cash effect +10; separate noncash lease 500.
fixtures.expected: Closing cash 1,010; noncash lease excluded from cash arithmetic and separately disclosed.

fixtures.title: GOLD-R2R-05 — equity
fixtures.inputs: Opening 5,000 + profit 900 + OCI 50 + contributions 400 − distributions 200 − approved opening error adjustment 100.
fixtures.expected: Closing equity 6,050; error adjustment is not current profit.

fixtures.title: GOLD-R2R-06 — whole-owned group
fixtures.inputs: Parent: Cash 5,000; IC AR 1,000; Investment 2,000; capital/retained equity −8,000. Subsidiary: Cash 1,500; inventory 1,500; IC AP −1,000; capital −2,000.
fixtures.expected: Combined assets 11,000. Eliminate IC AR/AP 1,000 and investment/subsidiary equity 2,000: group assets 8,000, liabilities 0, parent equity 8,000. Both source TBs unchanged.

fixtures.title: GOLD-R2R-07 — FX bridge
fixtures.inputs: Synthetic foreign entity: cash 100; capital −80; revenue −40; expense 20. Closing rate 4, historical capital rate 3.5, representative income/expense rate 3.6. These rates are test values, not market quotations.
fixtures.expected: Cash 400; capital −280; revenue −144; expense 72; calculated translation reserve −48; signed sum 0. Equity = capital 280 + profit 72 + reserve 48 = 400. A universal closing rate would give a different and prohibited treatment.
